post.summary: Creative mode: propose variations, let a critic judge them, breed the best
post.description: temperature 0 = the plain render (no search). Above 0 the engine adds related props, time/weather/background/palette ideas and new layouts, throws away any variation that drops or alters what the prompt asked for, and keeps improving the survivors with a small genetic search. The response says what it thought (header X-PixelMath-Prompt = the prompt it finally rendered; the same prompt + seed reproduces the image through /generate). With response=base64 the JSON also holds `creation` (thinking notes, scores, generations, rejected-by-critic counts, alternatives).

One premium niche picture for a website (restaurant, gym, dental, saas ...) with a built-in judge
post.description: The niche, mood and accent are read from the prompt ("gym with dumbbells in red light"). If no niche fits, a neutral abstract in the accent colour is returned and the report says fallback: true (never a wrong subject). With text_zone the area stays calm so text on it has contrast >= 4.5:1 (report.text_color says which colour to use). Binary answers carry X-PixelMath-Niche / -Fallback / -Redrawn / -Text-Color headers; response=base64 returns the full report.

200.description: JPEG/PNG bytes or JSON with base64 + report

post.summary: 3 to 8 pictures for one site in one style: hero (text zone), about, gallery tiles
post.description: Same niche, palette, mood and light; different camera and composition. The judge redraws any picture too close to another (perceptual hash distance) and reports redrawn / min_distance / palette_family / hero text contrast. response=zip (default) returns hero.jpg, about.jpg, tile-N.jpg and report.json; response=base64 returns JSON. Takes about 5-12 s.

post.summary: One picture for the client's picture spec: "<subject>, for a <business> website. ... Palette: accent #x on #y."
post.description: The business named in the prompt decides the scene (99 businesses + 20 business types of the spec), the slot (hero-1..3, about, gallery-1..6, card-1..6, team-1..3, background) decides size (1600x900, 1200x900, 900x900, 800x600, 600x600, 1600x900), camera and text zone. No text, letters or numbers are ever drawn; an unknown business gets a neutral abstract (fallback: true). Palette: accent and background from the prompt or the accent / bg fields; a dark background gives a dark picture.
